about.title: Full Stack, AI, SAAS Developer
about.about:
I am an undergraduate currently obtaining a B.S. in Computer Science at University of California, Riverside. I am seeking any opportunities to apply and leverage my skill set in sofware development.

My experience encompasses extensive work with HTML/CSS/Javascript, the Bootstrap Framework, VueJS, AngularJS, and NodeJS. My projects have often required integration using AWS Lambda, Google App Engine, and AWS API Gateway. With hands-on experience in both SQL and NoSQL databases, I have designed and executed numerous seamless integrations for back-end services and databases, closely aligning with the outcomes MindFire expects. Being well-versed in Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Salesforce.com, and Zapier, I can confidently say that my skill set resonates with the expectations of this role.

Beyond technical proficiencies, I am deeply familiar with the intricacies of digital marketing, from leveraging social media platform APIs to creating data-driven campaigns that resonate. My experience has also taught me the importance of being proactive and organized, especially in a fast-paced agency environment. I pride myself on my ability to multitask efficiently and maintain acute attention to detail, ensuring that every project I undertake is executed with precision and dedication.

Let's work together to bring your ideas to life! On a more personal note, I was born in Seattle, WA and grew up in Irvine, CA. My hobbies include surfing, tennis, skiing, cinema and coding
